about: Starter list for campus mode. Students can pick one to prefill, then edit anything. Every number here was checked against the school's own website on the date shown. Numbers change: re-check each one before adding or updating, and include the source link.

ride.name: Harvard campus escort (HUCEP)
ride.hours: Thu–Sat, 10:30 p.m.–3 a.m. Other times, HUPD can connect you with an escort or the Escort Van.

ride.name: MIT SafeRide
ride.hours: On demand 11 p.m.–2:30 a.m. Sun–Wed and 11 p.m.–3:30 a.m. Thu–Sat (TransLoc Rider app); fixed routes 6–11 p.m.

support.name: MIT Violence Prevention and Response (confidential)
support.hours: Weekdays 9–5; after hours the phone tree connects to 24-hour help

ride.name: Yale Security walking escort
ride.hours: Also in the LiveSafe app. The Campus Shuttle runs late at night too.
